name: doc-kit
description: One look for document pages (daisyUI 5 on Tailwind 4, prebuilt), with the skills that write them

scripts.build: sh scripts/build-kit.sh && python3 skills/doc-kit/scripts/dockit wrap src/sample.html -o skills/doc-kit/sample.html
scripts.test:figures: playwright install chromium && node tests/figure-check/run.mjs && sh tests/deck-gates.sh && sh tests/pictures.sh
